newsitem.title: USA: Hoechst, Transkaryotic ask for U.S. suit dismissal.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst, Transkaryotic ask for U.S. suit dismissal.

text.p: Hoechst Marion Rousell Inc and Transkaryotic Therapies Inc (TKT) have asked the U.S. District Court in Boston to dismiss a patent infringement lawsuit filed by Amgen Inc.

The suit, filed on April 16, asked the court to bar the companies from making, importing, using or selling erythropoietin (EPO) in the United States. The suit alleges infringement of several U.S. patents owned by Amgen.
In a release dated May 28, the companies said their technology does not infringe any Amgen patents and they will vigorously defend the lawsuit.
Since 1994, TKT and Hoechst, a unit of Hoechst AG of Germany, have collaborated on a treatment for anemia. They said the lawsuit appears to be aimed at that development program.
